7.description: [Stormgarde] Updated to the new tooltip paradigm to be more clear how this enchant works.

[Prayer of Preservation] Preservation can now only heal 3 targets down from 5. (This is intended to bring down the power this LRE brings to the table in Mythic + environments and the safety this heal provides.)
[Dragon Warrior] The damage of Dragon Roar has been decreased to 45% per stack, down from 50%. In addition, the weapon damage percent from Dragon Slam has been reduced to 200%, down from 210%.
Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker proc effect has now 100ms internal cooldown to prevent unintended proc behaviour with AoE abilities.
[Soul of the Warden] Fixed an issue where off hand attacks from Fan of Knives could not trigger weapon effects like poisons.
[Blade Vortex] Updated tooltip to new paradigm.

[Blade Vortex] Blade Vortex now reduces the attack speed granted by Blade Flurry by 50%, however the base damage of Blade Vortex has been increased by 200%.(This is intended to reduce the passive attack speed power this Mystic Enchantment provides and give it more AoE power in physical builds that choose to use this.)
[Snowblind] Updated tooltip to new paradigm.

[Snowblind] Ice Prism now has uncapped damage from 5 target max. This damage now shares damage on all targets hit, dealing full damage to up to 5 targets, and additionally reduced damage per extra target up to 10. Dealing damage to more than 10 targets will share damage to all targets hit, but not dealing more damage than if you were to hit 10 targets. This was previously target capped at 5 targets, with no damage shared. (This change is intended to increase the build’s AOE damage, while making it deal its damage more evenly)
[Wind Rager] Rampant Tornado now deals 15% more damage and has 15% increased scaling to its AP coefficient.
[Soul Harvest] Clarified the tooltip to state that it is usable while shapeshifted.
[Blood and Guts] Updated tooltip to new paradigm.

[Blood and Guts] Execute (Disembowel) can now hit up to 5 targets up from 3 targets previously. (This is intended to increase its AoE power in Raids and Dungeons, and give more AoE power to melee builds in general.)

These changes aim to help mold and shape the identity of Black Arrow. Currently, Black Arrow was only used as a filler ability to empower other Hunter Shots and had rarely contributed any meaningful damage to your breakdown. With these changes and the changes that hit live yesterday in mind, Black Arrow should take a slot amongst strong rotational spells while still being able to invest into empowering your other Hunter Shots and Abilities on targets affected by Black Arrow.
Black Arrow's DoT effect can now critically strike and will benefit from your ranged critical strike chance.
[Pending Restart] - Dark Hunting now increases the damage of Black Arrow by 10/20% (up from 5/10%)
[Pending Restart] - Black Arrow damage has been increased by 50%.

[Pending Restart] - Reduced the effectiveness of Mp5 gained from Spirit by 10%. This change is to slightly reign in the passive power granted by spirit and to make all forms of mana regeneration more powerful with the above change.

[Pending Restart] - Mana costs of ALL spells has been reduced by 20%. This change comes to help remedy mana regeneration issues and increase the effect that intellect has on how long you can sustain your mana. This change will also increase the effectiveness of which hybrids can operate w/o suffering a detrimental amount of mana issues and will also improve effects that restore total and or missing mana (because they will now have a greater effect in terms of your SPM (spells per mana)).

7.description: [Pending Restart] [Dark Ranger] Shadow Arrow now deals 90% weapon damage, down from 150% weapon damage, but instead deals additional damage scaling with player level. This change mainly impacts the first 50 levels of Shadow Arrow, with damage done at max level only slightly reduced.
[Pending Restart][Dark Apotheosis] Demon Spikes now has a 0.5 second GCD, down from 1.5 second GCD.
[Pending Restart] [Steward of Eternity] Fixed an issue where Synchronize incorrectly had an AP coefficient.
[Pending Restart] [Steward of Eternity] Time-bind and Time-bound now only increase the healing done by Align by 20% down from 40%.

[Pending Restart] [Steward of Eternity] Synchronize has had its base healing and coefficient reduced by 15%, most of the healing done by a fully stacked synchronize was overhealing and increasing align duration means you can cover more of a raid with align’s before casting Synchronize.

[Pending Restart] [Steward of Eternity] Synchronize now stalls time and freezes the duration of active align’s during its channel time. This means if a player has 6 seconds left on Align and you cast Synchronize, while the channel occurs the Align duration will not go down until you have finished channelling.
Changelog: [Pending Restart] [Steward of Eternity] Align now has a base duration of 8 seconds up from 6 seconds.
[Pending Restart][Darkmaster] Drain Soul now only deals double the normal damage when the target is at or below 25% health while using Darkmaster.
[Pending Restart][Darkmaster] Fixed an issue where Mind Blast could trigger Harvested Essence.
[Pending Restart][Darkmaster] Afflicted Soul can now be applied to targets affected by Ruptured Soul, allowing you to refresh the debuff.

[Pending Restart][Darkmaster] Fixed an issue where Ruptured Soul was not affecting all Shadow Damage over Time effects. This included Drain Soul and Drain Life. Because of this, Necromancer’s Touch now increases damage of Drain Life by 20%, down from 25%.
[Pending restart] Flame Born from the Burning Darkness Legendary enchant now increases the critical hit chance of your next Conflagrate by 15%. Down from 25%.
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Twilight Shock had slightly too high attack power scaling compared to Shadowburn.
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Razor Claws was giving more attack power scaling to Claw than intended.
[Pending restart] Razor Claws now makes Bloodthirst fully extend the duration of Rake (instead of adding 6 seconds) and makes Claw extend the duration of Rip by 1 second (instead of 2 seconds).
[Pending restart] The damage of Compound Shot has been increased by approximately 25%.
[Pending restart] Rip Shot now increases the damage of Steady Shot against targets with your Rip by 20%, down from 25%.
[Pending restart] Immolation Aura is no longer removed by being stunned while Dark Apotheosis is active.
[Pending restart] Fixed a bug which could cause Prayer of Preservation to have 10 seconds cooldown instead of the intended 12 seconds.

[Pending restart] Adorned from Champion of Justice now inherits some healing from the spell that triggered it, but its baseline healing has been reduced. This is intended to make Adorned healing less dependent on using many fast (even if weak) heals and more powerful when triggered by a big heal like Holy Light.

[Pending restart] Earth's Blessing can now trigger from Healing Touch in addition to Healing Wave. Rather than increasing Earth Shield healing (which has been increased baseline this update), it now grants 3% increased critical effect chance all heals per stack.
[Disciple of the Tides] Updated tooltip to new paradigm to be more clear.
[Fingers of Death] Updated tooltip to new paradigm to be more clear.

1.description: [Pending restart] Magma Totem is now capped to 10 targets. This will be a temporary solution until we implement damage normalization past 10 targets.
[Pending restart] The damage penalty applied to Mortal Strike, Slam and Overpower from Single-Minded Fury has been increased from 10% to 20%.
[Pending restart] Increased the weapon damage of Steady Shot from 125% to 150%. Its damage vs players has been reduced to offset this, so damage will only be increased against monsters.
[Pending restart] Effects that reduce attack power (such as Demoralizing Shout or Vindication) now affect both melee and ranged attack power.
[Pending restart] Immolation Aura now reduces the attack power of enemies hit for 30 seconds. This is intended to make attack power reduction more easily available for Metamorphosis tanks.
[Pending restart] The Tidal Mastery capstone effect now also procs from Riptide initial heal criticals, giving 2 a second duration increase to Tidal Force.
[Pending restart] Improved Earth Shield is now a 3-point talent, with a Capstone effect making Earth Shield heals grant a stack of Tidal Waves (if known). This effect can occur every 5 seconds.
[Pending restart] Earth Shield healing increased by 100% (!!!) in PvE only.
